answer: On the documented Claude Code contract re-fetched 2026-08-25, agent markdown supports the YAML keys name, description (required), tools, disallowedTools, model, permissionMode, maxTurns, skills, mcpServers, hooks, memory, background, effort, isolation, color, and initialPrompt. Command/skill markdown supports name, description, when_to_use, argument-hint, arguments, disable-model-invocation, user-invocable, allowed-tools, disallowed-tools, model, effort, context, agent, background, hooks, paths, shell, metadata, license, and compatibility. A subagent model is chosen in order CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the per-invocation model parameter, then the definition's model frontmatter, then the parent conversation model; omitted or inherit falls through. Agent tools/disallowedTools genuinely filter the tool pool a subagent receives. Command allowed-tools is advisory pre-approval and does not shrink the callable pool; command disallowed-tools does remove tools for that turn. This Linux estate has repo-root agents/ (18 md) and commands/ (71 md); ~/.claude/agents and ~/.claude/commands are absent; no claude CLI, so the shipped binary was not attached. Keys observed in repo files that are absent from the docs table (agent fallbacks/server-side-fallback; command `command` and underscore allowed_tools) are treated as unhonoured until a behaviour delta is measured. Fixture transcripts: restricted REFUSED Bash, unrestricted ALLOWED the same call.
